description: Data-only rules for eval/verify/claim-hygiene.ts: figures that were retired or qualified by the 2026-08-31 audit and its 2026-09-01 follow-ups, and the words that must travel with them. Live surfaces enforce the rules; historical reports under docs/benchmarks/ must carry an erratum/correction banner near the top when they still print a retired or unqualified figure. Verification lives in test/eval/verify-claim-hygiene.test.ts. No executable strings.

banner.note: A historical report that still prints a retired or unqualified figure must say so near the top (the 2026-04-23 and 2026-05-07 reports are the model). A dated `UPDATE (YYYY-MM-DD)` header counts: v0.6.1 put a 238-line re-run block above the May report, which pushed its erratum banner past the window (2026-09-04). Severity starts at warn so the gate lands green; flip to fail once every report carries its banner.

rules.note: The PrecisionMemBench default-hybrid figure is 0.075 (2026-05-30-gbrain-hybrid-body-text.json, meanPrecision 0.0752); 0.076 was the instrument sweep's off row. README carried 0.076 until 2026-09-01 (issue #26 gap 5).

Audit finding precisionmembench-01: 0.582 was measured with a seed-time shortcut and is an upper bound pending re-run on the fixed harness. Every mention on a live surface carries that qualifier in the same table row or paragraph.
Issue #24 finding 2: the 2026-04-23 relational scorecard predates the metric-helper fixes; live surfaces qualify 97.9% R@5 / 49.1% P@5 as pre-audit, re-measure pending.
Erratum 2026-08-31: 97.6% is any-hit recall@5, not the official recall_all@5 (83.4%). A live surface never prints 97.6% without naming the variant in the same row or paragraph.

The 2026-08-31 audit removed the unqualified SOTA claim from the README (docs-vs-code-06). Live surfaces do not claim it; historical reports that do must carry the banner. Exempt: SOTA inside double quotes is a quoted third-party claim (v0.6.1 comparison row `Supermemory "99% SOTA" post`), not this repo claiming it (2026-09-04).
